name: smwmusic-treasure-cove-dos-level
title: Treasure Cove (DOS) - Level 2
description:
My first attempt at a port using only SMW instruments. The song I used to learn was a song from one of my childhood DOS games "Treasure Cove," specifically level two:
https://youtu.be/TzdoxGrFS20?si=-i8_WQbmJsr-J57N

Short song, probably best used for shorter levels and tropical/beach/island themed levels.

Open to critique and feedback so that I can get better.
